## Email Line Breaks

```{r}
email <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/roualdes/data/master/email.csv")
```

### A: Plotting

```{r}
hist(email$line_breaks)
```

### B: Relevant Variables

```{r}
n <- length(email$line_breaks)
mean <- mean(email$line_breaks)
s <- sd(email$line_breaks)
```

### C: Confidence Interval

Two sided 95% CI

```{r}
alpha <- 0.05
stderr <- s / sqrt(n)
tstar <- qt(1 - alpha / 2, n - 1) # two-sided
margin_err <- stderr * tstar

ci <- c(mean - margin_err, mean + margin_err)
ci
```

### D: Hypothesis Test

$H_0$: $\mu = 250$

$H_1$: $\mu \neq 250$

```{r}
mu <- 250
t <- (mean - mu) / stderr
t

pvalue <- 2 * (1 - pt(abs(t), n - 1))
pvalue

pvalue < alpha
```

### E: Conclusion

Reject $H_0$ at the `r alpha * 100`% level.

### F: Practical Conclusion

There is strong evidence that the population mean number of line
breaks is not `r mu`.
